detail: Provide or connect the actual KB repo and its README/taxonomy/registers. The operating-plan counts cannot be verified here.
Robots returned User-agent:* Disallow:/. The reproduction licence does not override that. Obtain a permitted feed/export or written access arrangement; do not disguise the bot.
Decision portal returned 403. Stop that route; obtain permitted access or authorized human-provided metadata. No candidate count has been fabricated.
Record replies to the original plan’s questions 18/19 or explicit human approval of C3. General summary-only language does not override the specific C3 gate.
Full court terms timed out and official searches did not yield verified relevant candidates. Complete 40-candidate discovery with official metadata and subsequent-history checks.

OIPC guidance/index URLs returned 404. Province refers to May 2022 guidance while an indexed directory lists January 2022. Resolve the exact current document before claims about access exceptions, surveillance or retention.

Province records page still describes family-member tenant access, but newer tenant guidance says automatic assignment ended in 2022. Current SPA s.36 and ss.147–148 require the applicable rights analysis. Suppress stale guidance for this proposition.
Verify publisher-specific rights for bulk storage, embeddings, caching and redistribution. No government, tribunal, LTSA or BCFSA page is assumed to inherit the legislation licence.
SPA page read was current to September 22, 2026. Research occurred September 30. Verify intervening enactments/commencements before a current-law release.

Clarify supersedes direction in F1. Normally the new version points to the old; do not change the existing schema without checking README and validator. A judgment date is not a statute commencement date.
303/29/91 are reported in the brief, not independently reconciled. Count repealed, amended and composite provisions consistently. Proposed topic IDs are not the production taxonomy.

Approve A7 instrument scope, including PIPA and both additional strata regulations. Also decide whether BCHRT/OIPC decisions and Supreme Court of Canada authorities enter a later phase with their own rights checks.
Select municipalities and boundaries for leasehold, bare-land, mixed-use, developer, safety, title and winding-up questions. Do not claim province-wide local coverage.

Council-meeting guidance still references historical rental-exemption hearings; amendment wording can blur pet grandfathering date with filing effectiveness; special-levy footer citations need primary verification. Treat these as review flags, not automatic changes to law.
Arrange authorized documents and building/section ACLs. Public research cannot establish a building’s current bylaw, ownership designation, policy, account balance or lawful recipient.

The web research connector does not expose caller-set User-Agent or its robots decisions. This session is not evidence that a production crawler complies. Use a separate permitted importer with the required UA, pacing and logged access policy.
